messages:
jordan: quick idea 1 micro-followup for postmortems: tiny actionable note to lock owner+ETA+blockers before handoff :thinking_face:
maria: how's this different from our 72h PM?
jordan: 72h = full draft. micro = same-day, 3-5 fields, prevents ownership drift
sam: yes please. recurring issues often stall until the 72h and then die
lee: who starts it? IC or PM author?
jordan: IC starts the micro in-channel, assigns owner before shift ends. PM author becomes owner for the long run
maria: can we get a pasteable snippet to use in threads?
jordan: paste this:
```
MICRO-FOLLOWUP
- Owner: @owner
- Goal: short fix description
- ETA: YYYY-MM-DD
- Blockers: brief
- Recurrence risk: low/med/high
- Check-in: +48h
```
praveen: inc-bot should ping at +48h if no update
inc-bot: noted. can ping @owner at +48h when status is "open" (eng-sre opt-in)
sam: also log micro cards on remediation board (type: micro) so they don't vanish
lee: rotation rule: IC must @assign owner or squad lead takes interim ownership
maria: I'll add KB entry and examples by EOD tomorrow
praveen: I'll prototype inc-bot and board card, ETA 3 days
sam: adding checklist item and PR now
lee: will pilot on Wednesday IC shift and post results here
jordan: small experiment but should tighten followthrough and surface recurrence faster :rocket:
